menu.treadlightly.category.behaviour.too: What gets footsteps, and how they sit alongside the game's own.
menu.treadlightly.category.volume.toolti: How loud everything is, and how much of it you hear.
menu.treadlightly.group.entities.tooltip: Which things are heard walking, and how many at once.
menu.treadlightly.group.general.tooltip: Whether the mod runs, and how it shares the soundscape with the game.
menu.treadlightly.group.layers.tooltip: Extra sounds laid over a step: water, undergrowth, and the lift as something breaks into a run.
menu.treadlightly.group.sources.tooltip: Overall loudness, and how much each kind of thing contributes to it.
menu.treadlightly.group.stance.tooltip: How your own steps are paced. Rarely worth changing.
menu.treadlightly.option.client_player.d: Your own steps are played from stereo recordings, which sit wider than everyone else's.
menu.treadlightly.option.enabled.detail: Everything stops: no lookups, no sounds, and the game's own footsteps return immediately.
menu.treadlightly.option.enabled.tooltip: Turn the mod off without uninstalling it. The game's own footsteps come back.
menu.treadlightly.option.exclusive.detai: Leave this on unless you want both at once. When you are hosting for other players the game's footsteps are left alone regardless, since those are what your guests hear.
menu.treadlightly.option.exclusive.toolt: Silence the game's own footsteps for anything this mod covers, so the two are not heard on top of each other. Turning this off gives you both.
menu.treadlightly.option.foliage.detail: Only heard barefoot or while sprinting, and only over ground a pack has marked as overgrown.
menu.treadlightly.option.foliage.tooltip: How loud plants brushing against your legs are. Only heard barefoot, or when sprinting.
menu.treadlightly.option.footwear.detail: The surface is still heard underneath, just quieter, so you get the boot and the ground rather than only one.
menu.treadlightly.option.footwear.toolti: Add the sound of the boots being worn on top of the surface underfoot.
menu.treadlightly.option.hostile.detail: Turning this up is the cheapest way to hear something coming before you see it.
menu.treadlightly.option.hostile.tooltip: Volume of footsteps from mobs that attack you.
menu.treadlightly.option.max_entities.de: Past the limit, players and the nearest of each kind on a block are kept and the rest fall silent. Stops a mob farm costing one full solve per mob.
menu.treadlightly.option.max_entities.to: How many entities may have footsteps at once. Past this, players and the nearest of each kind are kept and the rest go quiet.
menu.treadlightly.option.multiplayer.det: Single player is unaffected either way. Turn this off if a server's own sounds already suit it.
menu.treadlightly.option.multiplayer.too: Whether footsteps play on multiplayer servers as well as in single player.
menu.treadlightly.option.other_player.de: Played from mono recordings so they place correctly in the world around you.
menu.treadlightly.option.passive.detail: Covers animals, villagers, and anything else that will not attack you.
menu.treadlightly.option.passive.tooltip: Volume of footsteps from everything else.
menu.treadlightly.option.running.detail: Applies gradually across the change from a walk to a run, rather than switching at a threshold. Zero keeps a sprint as loud as a walk.
menu.treadlightly.option.running.tooltip: Extra volume added as an entity works up to a run, so sprinting is louder than walking. Zero keeps them the same.
menu.treadlightly.option.stance.detail: Two legs places evenly spaced strides. Four legs falls in uneven pairs, the way a horse does.
menu.treadlightly.option.stance.tooltip: How your own footsteps are paced. Automatic picks two legs.
menu.treadlightly.option.targets.detail: Narrowing this is the cheapest way to cut what the mod costs in a crowd, since anything excluded is never solved at all.
menu.treadlightly.option.targets.tooltip: Which entities get footsteps. Narrowing this is the cheapest way to reduce the mod's cost in a crowd.
menu.treadlightly.option.volume.detail: Sets the ceiling for everything below. At zero the mod stops working altogether and the game's own footsteps come back.
menu.treadlightly.option.volume.tooltip: How loud footsteps are overall. At zero the mod stops working entirely rather than playing silence.
menu.treadlightly.option.wet.detail: Heard on waterlogged blocks, shallow water, and anything left out in the rain.
menu.treadlightly.option.wet.tooltip: How loud the splash layered over a step is when the ground is wet, waterlogged, or out in the rain.
menu.treadlightly.title: Tread Lightly
mod.treadlightly.name: Tread Lightly
